assumptions.model: ARB-15 fair_up with trailing 900s sigma and TWAP60
assumptions.cex_visibility: retrospective finalized 1s close with assumed extra 1s lag; no CEX receive times
assumptions.fair_value: fixed at decision for all arrival scenarios
assumptions.reference: Up L2 midpoint, Down=1-Up midpoint (paper reference only)
assumptions.fills: independent optimistic displayed-ask taker probes; no actual orders or fill probability
assumptions.slippage: adverse_ticks * arrival tick added to every consumed level; shifted price >=1 unavailable
assumptions.fees: negrisk.taker_fee per stressed level, half-up 5dp; no rebates
assumptions.no_fill_edge: null; zero surplus per requested share; excluded from filled edge distribution
assumptions.minimum: reject requested size or partial fill below market minimum
assumptions.book_clock: local received_ns, no interpolation, invalidate WS gaps
assumptions.depth_bucket: decision side ask quantity within 5 current ticks of best ask
assumptions.result_scope: descriptive short recording; complete means replay has signals, not statistical power
